bodyHtml:
pwsbuilder April 26, 2018

Saturday morning, April 28th, Guild members Carroll Sivco and Elaine Felos Ostrander are members of the Cape Cod Ukulele Club will be performing at 11 Am in the new Harwich Cultural Center (former Middle School) as part of their open house for #ArtWeekMA. We hope a lot of Guild members will come out to support them and this all volunteer music group. You will surely be entertained. Full schedule of events on the Town of Harwich website.

Posted in ArtWeek, EVENTS, WHAT'S NEW
Tagged ArtWeekMA, Elaine Felos Ostrander, The Guild of Harwich Artists
